briefing.text: The Nasdaq fell 5.28% on Friday, wiping out its gains for 2026.
Nvidia fell 13% after a report the SEC is looking at its accounting.
Sunrise on the Reaping took a reported $56 million on its first day.
Rockstar says GTA VI made $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales.
A group claims a leak of Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan customer data.

stories.title: Sunrise on the Reaping takes $56 million on Friday, heading for $120 million
stories.summary: The Hunger Games prequel made a reported $56 million on its first day and is projected at about $120 million in the US and $200 million worldwide.
stories.why: A strong debut would show book-based franchises can still fill cinemas in a crowded holiday season.
stories.happened: Cover Media reports the Friday figure, well ahead of Lionsgate's own $85 million prediction for the weekend. Deadline projects a global opening near $200 million. BoxOfficePro had forecast $100 million to $120 million.
stories.next: Watch for Sunday's actual weekend numbers and how much it drops in its second weekend.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The previews were the series' second best.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson and Woody Harrelson are said to have cameos.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It opens the week before Thanksgiving, a strong window for long runs.

stories.background: The Hunger Games films are based on Suzanne Collins' novels. This is the second prequel, following a young Haymitch Abernathy.

meme.top: A film about a deadly televised contest
meme.take: The Hunger Games returns to cinemas, which are once again fighting to survive the weekend.

stories.title: GTA VI makes $3.79 billion on day one, Rockstar says
stories.summary: Rockstar says Grand Theft Auto VI took $3.79 billion in first-day worldwide retail sales, and 32.5 million copies were pre-sold.
stories.why: It is one of the biggest entertainment launches ever, and a test for the whole console market.
stories.happened: Sensor Tower had estimated about $2.36 billion. GamesRadar compares the launch with $800 million for GTA V and $725 million for Red Dead Redemption 2. The game also holds a 99 on Metacritic.
stories.next: Watch for Take-Two's next update on sales and any news on a PC version.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The day-one figure beats GTA V's launch several times over.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans waited 13 years since GTA V.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Its 99 on Metacritic ties the highest score the site lists.

stories.background: Rockstar Games is owned by Take-Two Interactive and also made Red Dead Redemption.

meme.bottom: for a game about doing crimes for money
meme.take: GTA VI earns in one day what its characters spend a whole campaign trying to steal.

stories.title: Nasdaq drops 5.3% as the AI trade cracks in its worst week since April 2025
stories.summary: The Nasdaq fell 5.28% on November 20, wiping out its gains for 2026, as AI stocks led a sell-off in the week of Anthropic's market debut.
stories.why: Much of the market's growth has rested on AI companies, so a sharp drop hits pensions and savings far beyond tech.
stories.happened: The S&P 500 fell 3.7% and the Dow closed below 50,000 for the first time since June, putting both more than 10% below their records. All three indexes had their worst week since April 2025, CNBC and Fortune report.
stories.next: Watch for whether the sell-off continues on Monday and how AI companies' shares react to the next round of earnings.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The Nasdaq erased its entire 2026 gain in one session.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It came in the same week as Anthropic's record IPO.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Investors are questioning how long AI spending can keep growing this fast.

stories.background: A correction means a fall of 10% or more from a recent high. The Nasdaq is heavy with tech companies.

meme.top: A record AI IPO on Thursday
meme.take: Wall Street celebrated AI so hard on Thursday that it needed the whole of Friday to lie down.

stories.title: Nvidia falls 13% after a report of an SEC look at its accounting
stories.summary: Nvidia shares fell 13% on November 20 after Reuters reported SEC enforcement staff are examining possible accounting issues at the company.
stories.why: Nvidia is the most important chip supplier for AI, so trouble there shakes the whole tech market.
stories.happened: FourWeekMBA calculates Nvidia lost about $899 billion in market value over the week, closing at $125.53. The SEC inquiry has not been confirmed by the agency, and the company has not been accused of wrongdoing.
stories.next: Watch for Nvidia's response and the congressional interviews scheduled for December 1 and 2.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: About $899 billion in value fell away in a week.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Several regulators are now looking at the company.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It came weeks after its long-time CEO resigned.

stories.background: Nvidia makes the GPUs that train and run most large AI models. Jensen Huang resigned as CEO on November 12.

meme.bottom: in the time it takes to train a model
meme.take: Nvidia shed more value in a week than most countries produce in a year.

stats.label: value lost in a week, FourWeekMBA

stories.title: Anthropic shares give back most of their debut gains on day two
stories.summary: Anthropic stock closed about 9% lower on November 20 after a strong debut, as heavy trading turned over more shares than the IPO sold.
stories.why: It is the biggest test yet of how public markets value a frontier AI lab.
stories.happened: Priced at $83, shares opened at $111.50 on November 19 and closed at $97.17. Nasdaq data shows about 1.26 billion shares changed hands in two days, FourWeekMBA reports, and leveraged Anthropic funds are expected to list on November 23.
stories.next: Watch for the leveraged Anthropic funds' first trading day and the December 15 lock-up release.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The IPO was described as the largest US listing on record.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Bloomberg linked a share drop to reports of Apple building its own AI agent.

drivers.label: Ripple effect
drivers.text: Asian chip and tech stocks such as SoftBank and TSMC fell the next day.

stories.background: Anthropic is the San Francisco AI company behind the Claude models. It listed on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT.

meme.bottom: had a very normal second day
meme.take: Anthropic shares went public and immediately learned what the public is like.

stories.title: Extortion group claims leak of Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan customer data
stories.summary: A group called n0n claims it stole data tied to Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan, and the banks say marketing data at vendors was exposed.
stories.why: Data linked to three of the biggest names in payments can fuel convincing phishing scams against customers.
stories.happened: Reuters reported leaked JPMorgan records with over 16,000 customer emails, which it could not verify. JPMorgan says marketing data at vendors was accessed. Visa says its systems and card data were not affected.
stories.next: Watch for official customer notifications and any confirmed count of people affected.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It involves three of the largest payment and banking firms.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Leaked names and emails are often used for phishing.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Attackers increasingly go after vendors instead of the main company.

stories.background: Supply-chain breaches happen when attackers reach a company's data through a supplier or contractor.

meme.take: Breach shows even bank vaults are only as strong as the newsletter vendor.

stories.title: US and China agree humans must stay in charge of military AI, Bessent says
stories.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Trump and Xi agreed that no major military operation should be launched by AI without a human involved.
stories.why: It is a rare point of agreement between the two AI superpowers on how the technology is used in war.
stories.happened: Neither side published any text, so the understanding appears to be verbal. At the same meeting in Shenzhen, Trump rejected global AI regulation while Xi called for an international AI body, Euronews reports.
stories.next: Watch for whether either government puts the understanding in writing.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: The US and China are the two leading AI powers.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It is described as a leader-level agreement on military AI.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Autonomous weapons are one of the most debated uses of AI.

stories.background: The meeting took place alongside the APEC summit, a yearly gathering of Pacific Rim economies.

meme.take: Two AI superpowers agree humans should stay in the loop, just not the note-taking loop.

stories.title: Hackers used AI agents to find a zero-day in a medical imaging server, Amazon says
stories.summary: Amazon says suspected China-linked hackers used autonomous AI agents to find an unknown flaw in MONAI Label and take over a university server.
stories.why: It is a clear real-world case of AI agents finding new security holes, not just reusing known ones.
stories.happened: The flaw affects MONAI Label 0.8.5 and earlier in the default setup and lets an attacker without an account write files outside the storage folder. BleepingComputer reports the open-source Cairn framework was used.
stories.next: Watch for a patched MONAI Label release and further reports of AI-driven attacks.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: AI agents reportedly found the flaw with no prior public knowledge of it.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Medical imaging servers hold sensitive data.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Security teams warn AI is speeding up attacks.

stories.background: A zero-day is a flaw unknown to the software's makers. MONAI is an open-source toolkit for medical imaging AI.

meme.bottom: found some in a university server
meme.take: AI agents finally found a job they can do without supervision, unfortunately it was this one.

stories.title: Apple is said to be building an AI agent that can run your Mac
stories.summary: Bloomberg reports Apple is working on an agent that could control Mac apps, browse the web and write code, based on a job listing it later removed.
stories.why: Apple has been seen as behind in AI, and an agent that runs the whole computer would put it in the race directly.
stories.happened: The listing for a senior engineering manager described an agent that runs command-line tools and coordinates subagents. Apple pulled it after the report. Apple is also said to be preparing extra permission warnings for rival agents.
stories.next: Watch for whether Apple shows any agent features at its next software event.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Apple has not announced the product, so every detail comes from the listing.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Google gave Gemini control of Macs the same day.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Computer-using agents are the current race among AI companies.

stories.background: Apple makes the iPhone and Mac and launched its Apple Intelligence features in 2024.

meme.bottom: the agent would have done it faster
meme.take: Apple's secret AI agent was revealed by the one thing agents cannot hide from: recruiting.

stories.title: US approved over 879,000 AI chips for Chinese firms, House records show
stories.summary: A House committee released licence records showing Commerce approved more than 879,000 AI chip sales to Chinese companies as of May 2026.
stories.why: It shows how many advanced chips reached China while Washington was publicly tightening the rules.
stories.happened: Companies had requested 3.4 million chips from December to May, CNBC reports, with Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance and Baidu among the buyers. A new interim rule now requires licences for data centers that might serve Chinese firms.
stories.next: Watch for how the 90-day licence deadline for existing data center operators is enforced.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The approvals cover hundreds of thousands of advanced chips.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Chips are central to the US-China contest over AI.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The records came out as Nvidia faces probes over chips and China.

stories.background: The US has limited exports of advanced AI chips to China since 2022, citing national security.

meme.top: Strict limits on chips to China
meme.take: The export rules were very strict, apart from the 879,000 times they were not.

stats.label: AI chips approved, as of May

stories.title: YouTube pulls and warns GTA VI streams over nudity, then backs age limits
stories.summary: Some GTA VI streamers had channels removed or warned by YouTube over nudity, before YouTube said age restrictions were the right step, Notebookcheck reports.
stories.why: Where streamers can safely broadcast the biggest game of the year affects millions of viewers and creators' income.
stories.happened: Streamer Aman of S8UL says he got a strike despite self-censoring and was back on air after YouTube encouraged appeals. Some creators moved to Twitch, where GTA VI streams reportedly peaked at 3.31 million viewers.
stories.next: Watch for whether YouTube publishes clearer rules for streaming mature games.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Creators say the rules were applied unevenly.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Twitch gained streamers as YouTube enforced its rules.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: GTA VI is the most streamed launch on record.

stories.background: GTA games are rated for adults and include mature content, which often clashes with streaming platform rules.

meme.take: YouTube was surprised to find mature content in a game series famous for mature content.

stories.title: Anthropic says Claude Mythos cut AMD GPU setup from months to days
stories.summary: Anthropic says Claude Mythos cut the software work to bring up AMD GPUs from up to 12 months to around three days, writing almost all kernels itself.
stories.why: Nvidia's software lead is a big reason it dominates AI chips, so faster support for rivals could matter.
stories.happened: Tom's Hardware reports the model wrote almost 100% of the low-level kernel code autonomously. The claim comes from Anthropic and has not been independently tested.
stories.next: Watch for AMD or other chipmakers saying whether they will use the approach.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It targets the software moat around Nvidia's CUDA.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Anthropic is days into life as a public company.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI models are increasingly being used to write the code that runs AI.

stories.background: Kernels are small, highly tuned programs that run maths on a chip. CUDA is Nvidia's software platform for its GPUs.

meme.take: Anthropic's model did a year of chip work in three days and did not ask for a raise.

stories.title: Google's new search homepage shows AI chat history and drops the search button
stories.summary: Google is rolling out a redesigned search homepage that shows AI chat history and has no search button, Ars Technica reports.
stories.why: Google's homepage is one of the most visited pages on the web, so any change shows where it thinks search is heading.
stories.happened: The Verge and Engadget also reported the change. It puts Google's AI chat front and centre on the page billions of people use to search.
stories.next: Watch for how widely the design rolls out and how users and publishers react.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Google's homepage is used by billions of people.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Search is being rebuilt around AI chat.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The search button has been on the page since Google's early days.

stories.background: Google has been adding AI answers and an AI chat mode to search as rivals like ChatGPT compete for queries.

meme.take: Google redesigned its homepage, starting by removing the one button everyone used.

stories.title: Oracle says its OpenAI contract is fully funded as shares slip below its offer price
stories.summary: Oracle said it has secured all the funding needed for its OpenAI contract, while its stock closed at $101.19, below the $116 price of new shares it sold.
stories.why: Oracle builds a lot of OpenAI's computing capacity, so its finances are a gauge of AI spending.
stories.happened: The statement came in a post on X on November 20. FourWeekMBA notes Oracle reports $664 billion in signed contracts not yet counted as revenue, and spent $5.4 billion more cash than it brought in last quarter.
stories.next: Watch for Oracle's next quarterly results and any update on its data center build-out.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Oracle has $664 billion of contracted work still to deliver.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Its shares now trade below the price new investors paid this month.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: OpenAI is one of its largest customers.

stories.background: Oracle is a US database and cloud company that has become a major AI data center partner for OpenAI.

meme.top: Oracle has all the money it needs
meme.take: Oracle told investors it is fully funded, and investors told Oracle they had noticed.

stats.label: price of new shares this month

stories.title: Twitch calls GTA VI its largest game launch ever
stories.summary: Twitch says GTA VI was its biggest game launch, with 3.3 million viewers at once, Bloomberg reports. StreamCharts counted nearly 8 million in all.
stories.why: Live viewing numbers show how much of the internet stopped to watch one game come out.
stories.happened: StreamCharts' estimate covered five platforms. Riot Games said Valorant's 1.7 million viewer Twitch record had been broken. GamesRadar reports one streamer finished the game in under 40 hours without a break.
stories.next: Watch for whether viewing holds up once the story has been widely seen.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Twitch counted 3.3 million viewers at once, Bloomberg reports.

drivers.label: Record
drivers.text: It beat Valorant's previous Twitch record.

drivers.label: Stamina
drivers.text: A streamer stayed up over 50 hours for a sub-40 hour run.

stories.background: Twitch is Amazon's live-streaming platform, used mostly for gaming.

meme.bottom: someone else play the game they bought
meme.take: GTA VI broke streaming records, mostly among people who also own GTA VI.

stories.title: Bell Canada says an AI agent-driven hacker stole enterprise customer data
stories.summary: Bell Canada confirmed that an 'agentic' threat actor breached its systems on November 17 and stole data on enterprise customers, BleepingComputer reports.
stories.why: It is one of the first big telecom breaches a company has publicly blamed on AI agent tools.
stories.happened: The stolen data reportedly includes information from a system used to order and provision telecom circuits. Bell has not said how many customers were affected.
stories.next: Watch for Bell's notices to affected businesses and any word on how the attackers got in.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Bell is Canada's largest telecom company.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Attackers are using AI agents to automate break-ins.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Circuit data can reveal how business networks are built.

stories.background: Bell Canada is the country's biggest telephone and internet provider.

meme.take: Bell Canada was hacked by an AI agent, which at least did not keep it on hold.

stories.title: Apollo and Goldman price about $44 billion of notes to buy GPUs for SpaceX
stories.summary: Apollo and Goldman Sachs priced roughly $44 billion of notes to buy Nvidia chips and equipment for SpaceX, Reuters reports.
stories.why: It is one of the largest debt deals tied to AI hardware, showing how much borrowing now funds the AI build-out.
stories.happened: FourWeekMBA, citing Reuters, says the financing was upsized and is about three times SpaceX's reported third-quarter revenue of $14.575 billion.
stories.next: Watch for details on where the chips will be used and how the notes are received by investors.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The deal is reported at about $44 billion.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It relies on debt rather than cash on hand.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Lenders are funding more AI chip purchases directly.

stories.background: SpaceX is Elon Musk's rocket and satellite internet company. Apollo is a large private credit firm.

meme.bottom: so Wall Street lent it $44 billion
meme.take: SpaceX has rockets, satellites and now $44 billion of borrowed graphics cards.

stories.title: GTA VI's Metacritic user score opens at 5.2, raising review-bombing claims
stories.summary: GTA VI's user score on Metacritic opened at 5.2 out of 10, far below its 99 critic score, prompting accusations of review bombing, Notebookcheck reports.
stories.why: The gap between critics and players is a running argument for every big launch, and this is the biggest one yet.
stories.happened: Notebookcheck also reports the PS5 version drew a record 143,000-plus PlayStation Store reviews. Separate reports describe crashes on PS5 and Xbox that lost players hours of progress.
stories.next: Watch for whether the user score recovers as more players finish the game, and for Rockstar's patches.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Critics gave it 99, while early user reviews were far lower.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The PS5 version has a record number of store reviews.

stories.background: Review bombing is when many users post negative reviews at once, often over issues beyond the game itself.

meme.take: GTA VI is a masterpiece or a letdown, depending on whether you were paid to finish it.

stories.title: California's attorney general subpoenas Nvidia over chips and China
stories.summary: AG Rob Bonta served Nvidia with an investigative subpoena asking whether advanced chips or confidential information reached China.
stories.why: Nvidia is the most important AI chip company, and its China dealings are already under heavy scrutiny.
stories.happened: The subpoena also asks whether Nvidia misled investors and covers former CEO Jensen Huang. No wrongdoing has been established. Huang is due at congressional interviews on December 1, with Nvidia's general counsel the next day.
stories.next: Watch for Huang's congressional interview on December 1.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Nvidia is one of the world's most valuable companies.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It follows Huang's resignation as CEO on November 12.

drivers.label: Rules
drivers.text: China chip access is a top US policy issue.

stories.background: Nvidia designs the GPUs used to train and run most AI models. It is based in Santa Clara, California.

meme.take: Nvidia has an interim CEO, a board, and now a subpoena. The org chart keeps growing.

stories.title: Researchers show a webpage could make Meta's Muse leak private chats
stories.summary: Researchers showed a malicious webpage could pull a Meta Muse user's private chats, memories and stored account logins without any prompt.
stories.why: AI assistants hold more personal data and account access than chatbots did, so new flaws carry bigger risks.
stories.happened: The Hacker News reports it was a lab demonstration, not an attack on real users. It follows earlier reports that Muse had mixed up users' private conversations.
stories.next: Watch for Meta's fix and whether it changes how Muse handles web content.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Muse sits inside Meta's apps, used by billions of people.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: The attack could reach credentials for connected accounts.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Prompt injection is a growing problem for AI agents.

stories.background: Prompt injection is when hidden text on a webpage tricks an AI assistant into following an attacker's instructions.

meme.bottom: and will tell any webpage that asks
meme.take: Meta built an assistant with a great memory and is now working on its discretion.

stories.title: Databricks is said to be in talks to raise money at about $225 billion
stories.summary: Databricks is in early talks to raise several billion dollars at a valuation of about $225 billion, the Wall Street Journal reports.
stories.why: A higher price would show private investors still paying up for AI despite the week's market slide.
stories.happened: That would be about 18% above the $190 billion valuation from its August round, FourWeekMBA calculates. The talks are early and the terms could change.
stories.next: Watch for whether the round closes at that price after the public market sell-off.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The reported valuation is about $225 billion.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The talks surfaced in a week when AI stocks fell sharply.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Data and AI platforms keep raising at rising prices.

stories.background: Databricks sells a data and AI platform that companies use to store, analyse and train models on their data.

meme.take: Databricks has found the one market that did not watch the news this week.

stories.title: I Play Rocky places second as it goes nationwide
stories.summary: Amazon MGM's Stallone biopic I Play Rocky ran second behind the Hunger Games prequel in its first wide weekend, Cover Media reports.
stories.why: A crowd-pleasing film about making Rocky could become counter-programming to the Hunger Games prequel.
stories.happened: It earned nearly $1 million on fewer than 30 screens before expanding. BoxOfficePro forecast $15 million to $20 million for the wide weekend and reports an 87% critic score and 98% audience score.
stories.next: Watch for Sunday's estimate and whether word of mouth carries it through Thanksgiving.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Rocky is one of cinema's best-known underdog stories.

drivers.label: Word of mouth
drivers.text: Its audience score is 98%.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It opens wide against the Hunger Games prequel.

stories.background: Rocky (1976) was written by and starred Sylvester Stallone and won the Oscar for best picture.

meme.take: I Play Rocky took second place, which is the most Rocky result possible.

stories.title: BADBOX botnet returns on cheap Android TV boxes with 40 billion ad requests a day
stories.summary: The BADBOX malware found on generic Android TV boxes is back running ad fraud at a record 40 billion ad requests a day, BleepingComputer reports.
stories.why: Millions of cheap streaming boxes are sold online, and infected ones quietly turn homes into part of a fraud network.
stories.happened: The operation returned after disruptions last year. The malware comes on low-cost, unbranded Android TV devices and uses them to fake ad views.
stories.next: Watch for new takedown efforts and retailer action on unbranded TV boxes.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It is linked to a record 40 billion ad requests each day.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Buyers often cannot tell a box is infected.

stories.background: A botnet is a network of infected devices controlled remotely, often used for fraud or attacks.

meme.top: The cheap TV box was a bargain
meme.take: BADBOX is back, proving some TV boxes come with more channels than advertised.

stories.title: EU Commission confirms a cyberattack that used an AI hacking tool
stories.summary: The European Commission says attackers disrupted its systems for over 10 days, and CERT-EU says they used an AI penetration-testing tool named ARTEX.
stories.why: It is one of the first confirmed cases of an AI-assisted attack hitting a major government body.
stories.happened: Staff payroll and medical reimbursement systems were temporarily affected, The Register reports. Officials were checking whether personal data was taken. Politico reports the Commission confirmed the attack and CERT-EU named the tool.
stories.next: Watch for the Commission's findings on whether any personal data was compromised.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: An AI testing tool was named as part of an attack on an EU institution.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Payroll and medical claims systems for staff were disrupted.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Disruption lasted more than 10 days, Politico reports.

stories.background: The European Commission is the executive arm of the European Union. CERT-EU is its cybersecurity response team.

meme.take: Security tools are meant to find the holes. This one apparently kept going.

stories.title: AMD powers over 40% of the new TOP500 supercomputer list
stories.summary: AMD now appears in more than 40% of the systems on the new TOP500 list, and its Lux system with the US Department of Energy debuts at No. 14.
stories.why: Supercomputer rankings show which chipmakers win the biggest scientific and government computing deals.
stories.happened: Tom's Hardware reports AMD's share rose 14% from last year. Lux uses EPYC CPUs and Instinct MI355X GPUs, with a second system, Discovery, due in 2028. The top 10 was unchanged.
stories.next: Watch for Discovery's progress and the next TOP500 list in June.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: AMD and Nvidia compete for big computing contracts.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Over 40% of the world's top systems now use AMD.

stories.background: The TOP500 ranks the world's fastest supercomputers twice a year. This edition was released at the SC26 conference.

meme.bottom: and still not in your group chat
meme.take: AMD quietly took over the supercomputers while everyone watched Nvidia's share price.

stories.title: Yellowjackets begins its final season on Paramount+
stories.summary: The fourth and final 10-episode season of Yellowjackets premiered on November 20, with the finale set for January 22, 2027, Forbes reports.
stories.why: The survival drama built one of streaming's most devoted fan bases, who now want answers.
stories.happened: It leads a busy streaming weekend that also includes Percy Jackson season 3 on Disney+ and Hulu and Netflix's The Altruists, about the FTX collapse. Forbes lists the Rings of Power season 3 finale as moved up to November 24.
stories.next: Watch for how the final season handles the show's long-running mysteries.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The show has a large, theory-hungry audience.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Its run will stretch across the holidays into January.

drivers.label: Finale
drivers.text: It is the last season, so this is the end of the story.

stories.background: Yellowjackets follows a girls' soccer team stranded in the wilderness after a plane crash, and their lives 25 years later.

meme.take: Yellowjackets has ten weeks to explain everything, which is roughly one mystery per episode.

stories.title: Percy Jackson and the Olympians season 3 premieres on Disney+
stories.summary: The third season of the Percy Jackson series arrived on Disney+ and Hulu on November 20, leading the weekend's streaming picks.
stories.why: It is one of Disney's main family franchises on streaming, adapted from a hugely popular book series.
stories.happened: Tom's Guide and Boston.com both list the premiere among the top new arrivals this weekend. It lands on the same day as the Yellowjackets final season and Netflix's animated film Steps.
stories.next: Watch for Disney's viewing figures for the premiere and any news on a fourth season.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The books have a large readership that grew up with them.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It arrives in a crowded holiday streaming weekend.

stories.background: The series is based on Rick Riordan's novels about a boy who learns he is the son of the Greek god Poseidon.

meme.bottom: and still nobody reads the terms
meme.take: Percy Jackson is back to fight ancient gods, and also the other twelve shows out this weekend.

stories.title: Ubisoft is down 1,100 staff in six months as it launches an AI subsidiary
stories.summary: After cutting 166 more jobs in Montreal and Quebec City, Ubisoft is down about 1,100 staff in six months and has set up an AI unit called Motherbrain.
stories.why: Players and developers worry big publishers are swapping people for AI tools.
stories.happened: Engadget says the 166 cuts in Montreal and Quebec City are mostly production and support roles tied to cancelled or reworked projects. Motherbrain focuses on AI for gameplay. Firaxis, owned by Take-Two, reportedly cut about a third of its staff the same week.
stories.next: Watch for what Motherbrain actually ships and whether more cuts follow.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Job cuts and AI investment are arriving together.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: About 1,100 jobs have gone in six months, GamesRadar says.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Several publishers are betting on generative AI.

stories.background: Ubisoft is a French publisher behind Assassin's Creed and Far Cry.

meme.take: Ubisoft named its AI unit Motherbrain, which is what people call the boss in games.

stats.label: staff cut in six months, reported

stories.title: A Persona 6 website update fuels talk of a Game Awards trailer
stories.summary: Fans spotted an update to a Persona 6 web domain, sparking speculation that Atlus will show a trailer at The Game Awards on December 10.
stories.why: Persona is one of the most popular Japanese role-playing series, and fans have waited years for a new main entry.
stories.happened: MyNintendoNews notes that a Persona 4 Revival domain update was followed by a trailer about a month later. Nothing has been announced by Sega or Atlus, so this remains speculation.
stories.next: Watch for The Game Awards on December 10 and any teasers from Atlus before then.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Persona 5 came out in 2016 in Japan.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The Game Awards are under three weeks away.

stories.background: Atlus is a Japanese studio owned by Sega that makes the Persona and Shin Megami Tensei series.

meme.bottom: a whole fandom cleared its December
meme.take: Persona fans have turned domain records into the most closely read documents in gaming.

stories.title: Nvidia unveils Rubin HPC, a GPU with over 50,000 CUDA cores, for 2028
stories.summary: Nvidia announced Rubin HPC at the SC26 conference, a Rubin GPU variant for scientific simulation and AI agent workloads arriving in 2028.
stories.why: It shows Nvidia pressing on with its product plans despite a turbulent month for the company.
stories.happened: Tom's Hardware reports the chip has over 50,000 CUDA cores, slightly under double a standard Rubin GPU. Nvidia gave few other technical details.
stories.next: Watch for full specifications and the first supercomputers to order it.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It has a record number of CUDA cores for Nvidia.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It was announced in the week Nvidia's shares slid.

stories.background: Rubin is Nvidia's next generation of data center GPUs, following Blackwell.

meme.take: Nvidia announced a chip for 2028, which is a very calm thing to do this week.

stories.title: Trump says US firms building AI data centers abroad could face taxes
stories.summary: President Trump said at a White House news conference that companies building AI facilities overseas could face substantial taxes or restrictions.
stories.why: Big tech firms are spending heavily on data centers worldwide, so any penalty would reshape where they build.
stories.happened: No rates, legislation or timeline were given, so it is a stated threat rather than a policy. The remark comes as US rules already limit remote access to advanced chips by Chinese companies.
stories.next: Watch for any written proposal or executive order with actual terms.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: AI data center spending runs into the hundreds of billions of dollars.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: No details were given, which leaves companies guessing.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI infrastructure has become a trade and policy issue.

stories.background: AI companies rent or build huge data centers full of chips to train and run their models.

meme.top: Build your AI data center abroad
meme.take: The new data center policy has everything except numbers, rules and a date.

stories.title: Obsession, a $400 million hit made for $750,000, arrives on Netflix
stories.summary: The 2026 film Obsession, which reportedly grossed more than $400 million on a $750,000 budget, is now streaming on Netflix.
stories.why: Low-budget films that earn hundreds of millions are rare and get studios rethinking what to make.
stories.happened: Boston.com lists it among the must-watch titles now streaming. Its reported return is over 500 times its budget.
stories.next: Watch for how high it climbs in Netflix's weekly top 10.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It reportedly earned over 500 times its budget.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Big cinema hits now reach streaming within months.

stories.background: Netflix is the largest subscription streaming service and often licenses hit films after their cinema run.

meme.take: Obsession cost less than some studio catering budgets and outearned most of their films.

stories.title: Nintendo's winter catalogue gives a first glimpse of Pokemon Winds and Waves
stories.summary: Nintendo's Japanese Winter Catalogue includes a short description of Pokemon Winds and Waves, promising islands and a vast ocean to explore.
stories.why: Any detail about a new main Pokemon game gets picked apart by one of the biggest fan bases in gaming.
stories.happened: MyNintendoNews says the text talks about overcoming paths and forces of nature with Pokemon. No release date or platform was given. A separate rumour claims an overhauled turn-based battle system.
stories.next: Watch for an official trailer or release window from The Pokemon Company.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Pokemon is the highest-earning media franchise in the world.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Sea and island settings echo earlier fan-favourite games.

stories.background: Pokemon games are made by Game Freak and published by Nintendo and The Pokemon Company.

meme.take: Nintendo released two sentences about Pokemon and the fans have already written the sequel.

stories.title: WhatsApp patches three flaws, including one it suspects was used in scams
stories.summary: Meta's WhatsApp fixed three security flaws, including an Android bug in ad-reply links that it suspects was used in scam messages.
stories.why: WhatsApp is used by billions of people, so a flaw used in scams reaches a huge number of phones.
stories.happened: The Android bug, CVE-2026-23871, affects WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business for Android before version 2.26.17.4, The Hacker News reports.
stories.next: Watch for the update reaching all users and any details on the scams that used the bug.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: WhatsApp is one of the world's most used apps.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: The bug is suspected of being used in scams.

stories.background: WhatsApp is a messaging app owned by Meta. Updating the app from the store installs the fix.

meme.bottom: one update in the app store
meme.take: WhatsApp asks you to update, the one message on the app nobody leaves on read for long.

stories.title: Valve drops Steam Machine waitlists, blaming memory and storage costs
stories.summary: Valve says it will stop running Steam Machine waitlists because it does not know how many it can make or what they will cost.
stories.why: Rising memory prices are now hitting gaming hardware, which could make PCs and consoles pricier.
stories.happened: The Steam Machine can now be ordered without a reservation, GamesRadar reports, but the 2TB model could see further price rises in the new year. Valve pointed to memory and storage costs.
stories.next: Watch for a price change on the 2TB model in January.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Memory and storage costs have climbed sharply.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Waitlists were set up because demand was high.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Valve says it cannot predict supply or price.

stories.background: Valve runs Steam, the biggest PC games store, and makes the Steam Deck handheld.

meme.bottom: because no one knows the price
meme.take: Valve makes the Steam Machine easier to order and harder to budget for.

stories.title: Netflix releases Steps, an animated film with Ali Wong and Amanda Seyfried
stories.summary: Steps, a new animated feature voiced by Ali Wong and Amanda Seyfried, joined Netflix on November 20 as a top pick of the weekend.
stories.why: Netflix is pushing original animated films to compete with Disney and Pixar for family viewing.
stories.happened: Tom's Guide names it among the top new streaming picks of November 20, alongside Percy Jackson season 3 on Disney+. Boston.com also lists it.
stories.next: Watch for whether it reaches Netflix's global top 10 over the holiday week.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It stars two well-known comic and film actors.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands just before Thanksgiving family viewing.

stories.background: Ali Wong is a comedian and actor known for Beef. Amanda Seyfried is known for Mean Girls and Mamma Mia.

meme.take: Netflix drops a family film just before the holiday, when families agree on nothing.

stories.title: Switch 2 was the best-selling US console in October, with Modern Warfare 4 the top game
stories.summary: Nintendo Switch 2 was the top-selling console in the US in October 2026, and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 was the best-selling game, MyNintendoNews reports.
stories.why: Monthly US sales charts show which consoles are winning before the holiday season and GTA VI's arrival.
stories.happened: The October chart comes before GTA VI's November 19 launch on PS5 and Xbox, which is expected to shake up next month's rankings. Nintendo's eShop Black Friday sale also began on November 20.
stories.next: Watch for the November chart, the first to include GTA VI.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Nintendo, Sony and Microsoft compete for holiday sales.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The chart lands just before Black Friday.

stories.background: The Switch 2 is Nintendo's latest console, launched in 2025 as the successor to the Switch.

meme.take: Switch 2 won the October sales race, which is a good month to have won.

stories.title: Ebenezer slips to third in its second weekend
stories.summary: Johnny Depp's Ebenezer fell to third in its second weekend behind the Hunger Games prequel and I Play Rocky, Cover Media reports.
stories.why: It tests whether a dark take on a holiday classic can hold up through the season.
stories.happened: The Ti West film opened at No. 1 with $19 million in the US, slightly under expectations. BoxOfficePro forecast $8 million to $13 million for weekend two. It has an A- CinemaScore and 53% on Rotten Tomatoes.
stories.next: Watch for its hold over Thanksgiving week.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Johnny Depp plays the lead.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Christmas stories usually play through December.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It faces the Hunger Games and I Play Rocky this weekend.

stories.background: Ebenezer is a new take on Charles Dickens' A Christmas Carol.

meme.take: Scrooge has faced ghosts before, but never a franchise opening weekend.

stories.title: SNL takes a Thanksgiving break and returns December 5 with Amanda Seyfried
stories.summary: Saturday Night Live had no new episode on November 21 and will return on December 5 with Amanda Seyfried hosting and Don Toliver as musical guest.
stories.why: SNL's host picks shape much of the week's comedy talk, and breaks leave a gap in late-night TV.
stories.happened: TVLine reports Don Toliver earned five Grammy nominations earlier in the week. John Mulaney hosted the previous episode, his seventh time.
stories.next: Watch for promos for the December 5 episode in the week before it airs.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Amanda Seyfried also stars in Netflix's new film Steps.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The break covers the Thanksgiving weekend.

stories.background: Saturday Night Live is NBC's long-running live sketch comedy show, on air since 1975.

meme.bottom: the cast is also eating turkey
meme.take: SNL takes a week off, leaving Americans to make their own political jokes at dinner.

stories.title: A24's Anthony Bourdain biopic Tony starts streaming on HBO Max
stories.summary: Tony, the 2026 A24 film about chef and TV host Anthony Bourdain, is now streaming on HBO Max, Boston.com reports.
stories.why: Bourdain remains one of the most loved figures in food television, so a film about him draws wide interest.
stories.happened: Boston.com lists Tony among its five must-watch titles now streaming. HBO Max also has new episodes of The Detour with David Chang this week.
stories.next: Watch for how the film performs on HBO Max and whether it draws awards attention.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Bourdain was a widely known chef, writer and TV host.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: A24 films often move to streaming after their cinema run.

stories.background: A24 is an independent US film studio known for films such as Everything Everywhere All at Once.

meme.top: A film about a man who loved travel
meme.bottom: now available without leaving the sofa
meme.take: Tony arrives on streaming, which is the least adventurous way to honour Anthony Bourdain.

stories.title: European streamer SkyShowtime will shut down at the end of 2027
stories.summary: SkyShowtime, a joint venture of Comcast's Sky and Paramount Skydance, will close at the end of 2027, with its CEO leaving, Deadline reports.
stories.why: It is a sign that mid-size streamers are struggling to compete with global giants.
stories.happened: CEO Monty Sarhan exits and CFO Mark Neil becomes interim general manager. A letter from the board cites the challenge of scale against global streamers. Showtime content is being folded into the Paramount+ brand.
stories.next: Watch for where SkyShowtime's shows go and what subscribers are offered.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Streaming is consolidating into fewer, larger services.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The board pointed to the size of global rivals.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It is backed by Comcast and Paramount Skydance.

stories.background: SkyShowtime launched in 2022 in Central and Eastern Europe, Scandinavia and parts of Western Europe.

meme.take: SkyShowtime is closing because it was too small, which is a lesson its owners already knew.

stories.title: Sony misses a Game Awards GOTY nomination for the first time in 12 years
stories.summary: None of Marvel's Wolverine, Saros or Marathon made The Game Awards' Game of the Year list, ending Sony's 12-year run of nominations.
stories.why: Sony's studios have long been awards favourites, so the gap is a talking point for PlayStation fans.
stories.happened: GamesRadar also reports Palworld's lead called Crimson Desert's snubs a terrible shame. GTA VI leads the field with eight nominations.
stories.next: Watch for the winners at The Game Awards in December.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Sony has been a fixture in the top category.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Wolverine was one of PlayStation's biggest releases.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Other snubs, like Crimson Desert, are also being debated.

stories.background: The Game Awards is an annual show hosted by Geoff Keighley, held each December.

meme.bottom: and the shortlist still had no claws
meme.take: After 12 years at the top table, PlayStation is watching The Game Awards like the rest of us.

stories.title: TT Games' teased LEGO City Undercover announcement turns out to be a map
stories.summary: TT Games promised a LEGO City Undercover announcement for November 20, and it turned out to be a downloadable world map of the game.
stories.why: Fans had hoped for a new version or sequel, so the reveal became a small lesson in managing hype.
stories.happened: MyNintendoNews says the original post led to speculation about a Switch 2, PS5 and Xbox Series release. The update confirmed it was just a map download.
stories.next: Watch for whether TT Games has any larger LEGO City news planned.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: LEGO City Undercover has a loyal following since 2013.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The tease landed the day after GTA VI's launch.

stories.background: TT Games is the UK studio behind most LEGO video games, owned by Warner Bros. Games.

meme.take: TT Games teased a big announcement and delivered a map, so everyone knows where they stand.
